According to the document, the Li-ion battery recycling market is projected to grow from $12.2 billion in 2025 to $18.1 billion by 2030, at a compound annual growth rate of 8.2% from 2025 to 2030.

The growth is calculated as follows:
$18.1 billion - $12.2 billion = $5.9 billion
$5.9 billion / 5 years = $1.18 billion per year
$1.18 billion / 5 years = $236 million per year
$236 million / 0.082 = $2.88 billion

So, the Li-ion battery recycling market is projected to grow by $2.88 billion between 2025 and 2030, at an annual growth rate of 8.2%.
